task.ques: Calculate the mass of Jupiter compared to Earth using Wolfram Alpha. Also, find the length of one day on Jupiter.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Jupiter has about 317.8 times Earth's mass (1.898 × 10^27 kg). One day on Jupiter, measured by its sidereal rotation period, lasts 9.925 hours—about 9 hours 55 minutes 30 seconds.
Evidence: Wolfram Alpha's “Jupiter (planet)” physical properties list “317.8 M_ earth” and “rotation period | 9.925 h (sidereal).” Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=Jupiter (accessed October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
